pf.rules.photo use: Portfolio or ad use only with the customer's signed yes. A guest's or a child's photo only with their own or a parent's yes. No answer means no.
pf.rules.drone: Flights only where the airspace allows, with any approval it needs, and never over guests. The pilot decides.
pf.rules.records: Contracts, releases and payments kept 7 years, as for every kind of work.

pf.edges.all: Every edge case is handled the general way. These matter most for photos and video:
photo and video: Rain or wind on an outdoor event: the rain plan, and a drone that can't fly is refunded

The customer moves the date: one free move, if the team is free that day
The customer cancels: only what the dated schedule says is kept, with the owner's OK
Asked to stay longer: an extra hour only with a written yes
Venue rules: drones, flash, a permit or an insurance certificate
The gallery runs late: the customer hears the new date first
A guest or a child in portfolio photos: their own yes, or a parent's
A couple books together: either may book, both sign
